title: celtis alnifolia
intro: Celtis alnifolia, commonly known as Hackberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Celtis alnifolia include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe and heal wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
